name: heuresis
description: Idea triage: capture an idea in plain text, search papers, patents, products and your own work for anything like it, and file it with a verdict grounded in records a script has checked.

ideas_repo.title: Ideas repository
ideas_repo.description: Local clone of your private ideas repository. /heuresis:setup creates it if it does not exist yet.

repos_root.title: Repositories folder
repos_root.description: Folder holding your repo clones (papers, talks, your projects). heuresis reads your bibliography, notes, decks and ROADMAPs from here.

openalex_api_key.title: OpenAlex API key
openalex_api_key.description: Raises OpenAlex's search budget; free at openalex.org/settings/api.

s2_api_key.title: Semantic Scholar API key
s2_api_key.description: Adds Semantic Scholar; request one at semanticscholar.org/product/api.

lens_api_token.title: Lens API token
lens_api_token.description: Adds worldwide patents; request API access in your lens.org profile.

epo_ops_key.title: EPO OPS key (save with the secret)
epo_ops_key.description: Adds European patents; register at developers.epo.org.

epo_ops_secret.title: EPO OPS secret (save with the key)
epo_ops_secret.description: Adds European patents; register at developers.epo.org.
